entities.summary: TVQ Kyushu Broadcasting Co., Ltd. , callsign JOTY-DTV is a Japanese television station based in Fukuoka that serves as the affiliate of the TX Network for the Fukuoka Prefecture. TVQ Kyushu Broadcasting is a television station in Fukuoka, established in 1991. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
